source_text: Voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) programs in Africa, informed by randomized controlled trials (RCTs) in Kenya, Uganda, and South Africa, have demonstrated reductions in the acquisition of other sexually transmitted infections (STIs) beyond HIV.
